artworks.label: Peach raincoat
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for peach-puddle. One tiny empty peach-coloured raincoat with a round hood, soft sage-green toggle buttons and two little patch pockets, draped on a simple twig hanger, one small coral petal at its hem. Flat2D soft chalk-pastel and coloured-pencil picture-book drawing, visible dry pigment grain, gently smudged edges, fine cocoa pencil details, peach/custard/sage/dusty-coral palette. No3D, no duckling, snail, umbrella, boot or boat; raincoat itself is the new subject. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
